law_record.title: Curb marking color code (B)
law_record.text: The parking of vehicles is prohibited or restricted in certain zones as set forth in this Section. The location of such zones shall be established by posting appropriate signage or other durable markings, by painting curbs or the edges of road surfaces in accordance with the colors listed below, or by a combination thereof: Yellow indicates a zone for: (1) Commercial vehicles to stop, stand or park for the purpose of loading or unloading freight in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign; and (2) Taxicabs to stop, stand, park for the purpose of loading, unloading or waiting for passengers in accordance with the conditions and times posted on an accompanying sign.

activation_conditions: the curb is painted yellow, with a sign stating the conditions and times
the subject stops, stands or parks there
exceptions: commercial vehicles loading or unloading freight, per the posted conditions and times
taxicabs loading, unloading or waiting for passengers, per the posted conditions and times
residue: 'commercial vehicle' status is read from markings; the freight or passenger purpose from the loading observed
summary.subject: driver

timing_requirements.requirement: the zone's conditions are time-bounded by its sign; outside those hours the ordinary rules govern
the entitlement is judged while the vehicle stands
